short.q: Explain the difference between strophic and through-composed.
short.model: Strophic repeats the same music for each verse; through-composed has new music for each section of the words.

short.q: Describe how film music creates tension.
short.model: Tremolo strings, low sustained notes, dissonance, ostinato and a gradual crescendo.

short.q: Describe two features of Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring.
short.model: Irregular, changing metre with strong accents; ostinato, dissonant chords and a large orchestra with powerful percussion.

short.q: How does a pop song or musical song build to a big chorus?
short.model: It adds instruments and voices, crescendos and raises the intensity, with a memorable repeated hook.

short.q: Give two features of video game music.
short.model: Loops that repeat seamlessly; layers added or removed with the action; often orchestral or electronic sounds.
